text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right after wrapping up training with Manhattan Cafe on that day—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Um... would it be okay
if I trained... a little more?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Since there are... a lot of people today...
I think I can gain some good experience, so..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Manhattan Cafe can see
"something" that is invisible to others.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, they're calling for me...
Um, may I... go over?
choice_data_list: It's getting late, so why don't we save it for next time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe, running all alone
on the nighttime track...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Strangely, it sounded like multiple sets of footsteps... but they all sounded like cheerful ones.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
It's getting quite dark out, after all...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
...I'll let them know maybe next time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After excusing herself to an unseen 'presence,'
she brought that day's training to a close."
